lemma soda_safe_cube (h : 0<μ) (he : μ≤1) (hp : p∈strip (μ*(1/128))) : (1/2:ℝ)*pebWeight p μ ≤ ‖soda μ p‖ := by
  have ht : ‖soda μ (ground p)‖ = pebWeight p μ := by
    unfold soda; rw [stone_real (ground_real _), shadeK, ground_up, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_add,norm_real]; exact Real.norm_of_nonneg (peb_pos p h).le
  have hc : soda μ p-soda μ (ground p)=stone p-stone (ground p) := by unfold soda; rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
  have hx := norm_sub_norm_le (soda μ (ground p)) (soda μ p)
  rw [ht,norm_sub_rev,hc] at hx
  have hv := shade_stone _ _ (ground_near hp).le (by linarith : μ*(1/128)≤1); unfold pebWeight at *
  nlinarith only [hv,hx, sq_nonneg (shadeK p-μ),sq_nonneg μ]

proof_context.conclusion: On the strip of width μ/128 the complex denominator `soda μ p` has modulus at least half the real weight `pebWeight p μ`, using `shade_stone` to bound its change from the real point.

lemma thin_doubled (L : Side) (hl : Odd L.val) (hp : p∈strip (1/128:ℝ)) :
    bags (Slab.basic _) (Slab.basic _) p p (furnish L (fun q : Momentum => damp (inch L) q^3 • (1:CompM α α)) p)
      ((Real.exp (1/128*4)*((Fintype.card α:ℝ)*(8*jointMoney)))*Real.exp (1/128*4)) := by
  unfold bags carryM Slab.basic; simp only [inv_one,Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one,furnish]
  let f (l : Co L α) := damp (inch L) (aliasAt p l.1)^3
  rw [show posterBlock L _ p= diagonal f by
    ext ⟨i,a⟩ ⟨j,b⟩; unfold posterBlock fiber; by_cases h : i=j <;> by_cases h1 : a=b <;> simp [f,h,h1, Matrix.one_apply,Matrix.diagonal_apply]]
  have ht : ∑ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ (Fintype.card α:ℝ)*(8*jointMoney) := by rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; simp only [f, Finset.sum_const,card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul]; rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (budgetRun L hl hp) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
